contracts.name: ThresholdCount.sq_excess_le_card_mul_sum_sq
contracts.contract: For any finite s and real f, if theta >= 0 and theta * card(s) < sum(s,f), then (sum(s,f)-theta*card(s))^2 <= card({i in s | theta < f(i)}) * sum(s,f^2).
contracts.extra_notes: No sign condition on f; no Fintype or DecidableEq iota premise.

contracts.name: ThresholdCount.sq_excess_div_sum_sq_le_card
contracts.contract: Under the same hypotheses, (sum(s,f)-theta*card(s))^2 / sum(s,f^2) <= card({i in s | theta < f(i)}).
contracts.extra_notes: Proof derives strict positivity of the denominator.
